req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json content type for all echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must return application/json content type. Tests cover: (1) positive EP cases for each HTTP method verifying exact Content-Type header value and 200 status; (2) negative cases verifying wrong methods return 405 (not 200, not JSON); (3) boundary cases verifying the Content-Type value contains exactly 'application/json' and not a superset/subset string. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 vs 405), exact Content-Type strings, and exact JSON structure keys.

tests.name: test_get_returns_application_json_content_type
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    assert r.content_type.startswith('application/json')
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'origin' in data

test_get_returns_application_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_post_returns_application_json_content_type

expected: Response body is valid JSON with expected keys

    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'form' in data
    assert 'json' in data

test_post_returns_application_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html
actions: Send requests to all five echo endpoints
Assert Content-Type is exactly application/json and NOT text/html or text/plain
trace: boundary between JSON and non-JSON content types
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} status={r.status_code}"
        ct = r.content_type
        assert 'application/json' in ct, f"{method} {path} content_type={ct}"
        assert 'text/html' not in ct, f"{method} {path} content_type={ct}"
        assert 'text/plain' not in ct, f"{method} {path} content_type={ct}"

test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html()

tests.name: test_get_response_body_is_parseable_json_with_exact_keys
actions: Send GET request to /get with query param
expected: No extra unexpected top-level keys beyond those four
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_response_body_is_parseable_json_with_exact_keys():
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}
    assert set(data.keys()) == expected_keys
    assert data['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}

test_get_response_body_is_parseable_json_with_exact_keys()

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_status_200_exact
preconditions: All five echo endpoints exist and are reachable
actions: Send correct HTTP method to each echo endpoint
Assert status code is exactly 200 (not 201, not 204, not 2xx range)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_status_200_exact():
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in cases:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} got {r.status_code}"
        assert r.status_code != 201
        assert r.status_code != 204
        assert r.status_code != 199
        assert r.status_code != 301

test_all_echo_endpoints_status_200_exact()
